description: Establish and confirm a green baseline before making changes. Dependencies and Playwright browsers are already installed in this sandbox during routing, but the coder must re-verify the toolchain and record the baseline so any later failure is attributable to the change, not the environment.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/laya-browser-mcp run `pnpm install` (idempotent) to confirm deps are present.

Confirm browsers: `pnpm exec playwright install chromium firefox` (already downloaded; this is a no-op verification). webkit host libs are unavailable in this sandbox and its cross-browser case self-skips - do not treat that as a failure.
Run `pnpm typecheck` and confirm it passes with no errors.

Run `pnpm test` and confirm the suite is green: expect ~244 passed / 2 skipped. If test/cross-browser.test.ts fails with 'firefox is not installed', run `pnpm exec playwright install firefox` and re-run; it then passes (webkit case skips).
Record the exact baseline test counts in this feature's findings.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm test` is green (all suites pass; only skips are the documented webkit/host-limited cases).
Baseline test counts are recorded in findings.
findings:
Green baseline confirmed on branch fix/overlay-ux-blue (HEAD 15663c8). Steps run from /projects/sandbox/laya-browser-mcp:
- `pnpm install`: idempotent, 'Already up to date' (exit 0). Warning about ignored build scripts (esbuild, onnxruntime-node) is pre-existing and harmless.
- `pnpm exec playwright install chromium firefox`: no-op verification, exit 0. Note: Playwright prints 'BEWARE: your OS is not officially supported ... downloading fallback build for ubuntu24.04-x64' - expected in this sandbox, not a failure. webkit host libs remain unavailable; its cross-browser case self-skips.
- `pnpm typecheck` (tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit): PASS, exit 0, no errors.
- `pnpm test` (vitest full suite): GREEN, exit 0. Test Files 37 passed (37). Tests: 245 passed | 3 skipped (248 total). Duration ~17.9s wall. firefox was already installed so no cross-browser reinstall was needed; the only skips are the documented webkit/host-limited cases.

Baseline counts to compare later changes against: 37 test files, 245 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed. (Slightly higher than the briefing's ~244/2 estimate; suite is fully green with only documented skips.) No source code changed in this feature.
